appDesc.message: Find, preview, filter, and batch download images from web pages.

donotshowdialogagain.message: Do not show this dialog again

foundLabel.translation_note: leave the '%n', it will be replaces with the number of images found, ie 'Found 22 images'

heightLabel.translation_note: the height is intended as the pixel 'height' of the image

makesurechrome.message: Make sure you don't have selected the 'Ask where to save each file before downloading' checkbox in Chrome Settings --> Advanced --> Download section.

makesurefirefox.message: Make sure you don't have selected the 'Always ask where to save files' checkbox in Firefox Settings --> Files and Applications section.

manyfilesnum.translation_note: leave the '%n', it will be replaces with the number of download images , ie 'Download 22 images'

otherwisechrome.message: Otherwise Chrome by design will popup the Save as... dialog for each file :-(

otherwisefirefox.message: Otherwise Firefox by design will popup the Save as... dialog for each file :-(

welcomeFeature1Desc.message: Finds images from tags, CSS backgrounds, srcsets, SVGs, shadow DOM, and lazy-loaded content.

welcomeFeature2Desc.message: Filter by size, type, or URL pattern. Sort and select exactly what you need.

welcomeFeature3Desc.message: Download selected images individually or as a ZIP archive. Custom naming and subfolder support.

welcomeFeature4Desc.message: All processing happens locally. No data sent to external servers. No tracking. No analytics.

welcomeShortcutLabel.translation_note: followed by the keyboard shortcut keys (Ctrl + Shift + Y), which are not translated

welcomeSubtitle.message: Discover, filter, and batch download every image on any web page — fast, private, and completely offline.

widthLabel.translation_note: the width is intended as the pixel 'width' of the image

downloadAllImagesMenu.message: Download all images on this page
